description:
Cast Submerge without paying its mana cost, targeting Venser.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Venser.
Put either Venser into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Venser's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Submerge to your hand.
Repeat.
